title: SGS (Students' General Secretary)

posts.md:
The **Students' General Secretary (SGS)** is the overall representative of the student body at IIT Madras.

The SGS coordinates student welfare, campus amenities, academic support, and several institute-wide initiatives while representing student concerns before the institute administration.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the SGS.

## Contents

Academic Support & Preparation

Mental Health, Welfare & Social Initiatives

Student Governance & Guest Lectures

Technology & Public Infrastructure

## Academic Support & Preparation

## Pragati

Pragati is the institute's academic support initiative, helping students excel academically and prepare for competitive examinations.

### Activities

- Academic mentoring through peer support

- UPSC preparation resources and guidance

- CAT & MBA preparation support

- Career-oriented workshops

- Academic resource sharing

### Sub-Clubs

### UPSC Club
Supports students preparing for the Civil Services Examination through structured resources, mentorship, and test series.

### Academic Mentorship Cell (AMC)
Pairs students with experienced **Acad Buddy Mentors** to provide academic guidance and support.

### CAT Club
Provides guidance for CAT preparation, MBA admissions, management careers, and finance opportunities.

### Social Media & Designing
Handles publicity, branding, and creative design for all Pragati initiatives.

## Mental Health, Welfare & Social Initiatives

## Saathi

Saathi promotes student well-being through awareness programs, mentoring, wellness initiatives, and community engagement.

### Activities

- Mental health awareness

- Student mentoring

- Wellness workshops

- Self-development initiatives

## IIT for Villages (IViL)

IIT for Villages (IViL) works on rural development and community outreach through student-led social impact projects.

### Activities

- Rural development projects

- Community outreach

- Social impact initiatives

- Village engagement programs

## Student Governance & Guest Lectures

## SGS Executive Committee

Assists the Students' General Secretary in addressing student concerns and improving campus life.

### Responsibilities

- Address student grievances

- Monitor campus issues

- Support SGS initiatives

- Coordinate with student bodies

## Extra Mural Lectures (EML)

Organizes lectures, talks, and interactive sessions featuring distinguished personalities from academia, industry, government, entrepreneurship, and other fields.

## Technology & Public Infrastructure

## Institute Web Operations (WebOps)

Develops and maintains the institute's student-facing digital platforms.

### Platforms

- Students IITM

- IITM Maps

- Course Reviews

- Feedback Portal

- Student organization websites

### Activities

- Website development

- Platform maintenance

- Technical support

- Digital infrastructure

## Campus Facilities Monitoring Committee (CFMC)

Works with the institute to identify and improve campus infrastructure.

### Areas Covered

- Security systems

- Street lighting

- Civil infrastructure

- Campus shuttle services

- Student feedback on facilities

## Disaster Management Committee (DMC)

Promotes campus safety and disaster preparedness.

### Activities

- Disaster preparedness

- Safety awareness campaigns

- Emergency response planning

- Student safety training

**Did you know?**

Many of the platforms and initiatives you use every day—from **Students IITM** and **Course Reviews** to **academic mentoring, wellness programs, campus infrastructure feedback, and guest lectures**—are managed by these SGS student bodies. They're a great way to contribute to campus life while developing leadership, technical, and organizational skills.
